culprit_citations.quoted_text: Non-controlled, non-affiliated investments, at fair value (cost of $ 186,110 and $ 229,254, respectively) | $ | 183,056 | $ | 225,617

rationale: A04 compares the extracted holdings fair value of 173,214,000 with the filing's current-period investment total. The raw filing reports 183,056 thousand as total investments in the SOI and repeats 183,056 thousand for non-controlled, non-affiliated investments on the balance sheet. The 9,842,000 shortfall is therefore an extraction gap, not a bad filing anchor; the allowed source view did not cleanly localize the residual to a single omitted row or subtotal.
